name: wada-colors
description: Universal AI Agent Skill & Sanzo Wada 1930s Color Combinations (Haishoku Sōkan) for modern app design systems

scripts.serve: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p=path.join(__dirname, 'web', req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.startsWith('/data/')?'..'+req.url:req.url); if(req.url.startsWith('/data/')) p=path.join(__dirname, req.url); if(!fs.existsSync(p)){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not Found');} const ext=path.extname(p); const ct={'': 'text/plain', '.html':'text/html', '.css':'text/css', '.js':'application/javascript', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml'}[ext]||'text/plain'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':ct}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(3333, ()=>console.log('🌸 Wada Colors Gallery running at http://localhost:3333'));"

author: Wada Colors Contributors
